items.b: GAHCHO KUE SOLD 111% MORE CARATS AND TOOK 44% LESS FOR EACH
items.t: Mountain Province sold 869,520 carats in the quarter to 30 June against 411,114 a year earlier, at CAD 50 a carat against CAD 90. Revenue rose 18% to CAD 43.5 million.

items.b: A RECORD RECOVERY QUARTER UNDERNEATH IT
items.t: Carats recovered reached 2,014,563, up 185% and the second consecutive quarter above two million. Cash cost fell to CAD 48 a carat recovered from CAD 209.

items.b: AND A NET LOSS 2.8 TIMES THE QUARTER'S REVENUE
items.t: The loss was CAD 120.6 million, or 57 cents a share, against CAD 37.7 million a year ago, while adjusted EBITDA turned positive at CAD 8.4 million. Disclosed FX losses account for CAD 11.3 million of the gap.

items.b: ASIAN STAR'S LOOSE DIAMONDS FELL 22% AND ITS JEWELLERY ROSE 17%
items.t: Consolidated revenue fell 11% to INR 6.47 billion in the June quarter and 13% against the March quarter. Net profit fell 38% to INR 120.6 million, a net margin of 1.86%.

items.b: TWO METALS COULD BE MARKED THIS MORNING AND TWO COULD NOT
items.t: Kitco at 06:04 New York read gold $4,393.10 and silver $65.00, both corroborated on TradingEconomics within 0.2%. Both are written back to the tape.

items.b: PALLADIUM'S TWO PAGES ARE NOW 1.46% APART
items.t: Kitco read $1,303.00 against TradingEconomics at $1,322.00. Platinum's gap is 0.66%. Both metals hold their 17 August marks, $1,311.00 and $1,749.00, for a second session.

items.b: IIJS PUBLISHED ITS GATE AND NOT ITS TILL
items.t: India's flagship show closed on 10 August with more than 50,000 trade visitors, 2,100 exhibitors and 2,700 international buyers. Eight days on, this desk can find no published business value.

items.b: A CORRECTION RAN THIS MORNING ON TWO PAGES
items.t: The $31.4 million Sotheby's High Jewelry figures this paper printed on 24 July and again in yesterday's lead describe the sale of 13 June 2025. The 2026 sale ran on 16 June and made $43.4 million.

items.b: WHAT DID NOT PRINT TODAY, AND WHICH DESKS ARE DARK
items.t: Gemstones is dark a seventh consecutive edition and watches a sixth, both counted from the raw per-edition mix. The Federation's July Swiss export print is scheduled for 20 August. Sotheby's still carries no total for the Gem Drop August or the Arcade Sale Hong Kong, re-checked today.
